title: Wife's demand for share in ancestral property amounts to dowry demand if made under husband's pressure: Calcutta HC
description: The Calcutta High Court recently held that a wife's demand for her lawful share in ancestral property, if made under pressure from her husband, may amount to a dowry demand.A Division Bench of Justice Arijit Banerjee and Justice Apurba Sinha Ray made the observation while partly allowing an appeal against the conviction of a husband in a dowry death case.In the July 2 judgment, the Court observed that while a woman is legally entitled to claim her share in ancestral property, such a claim would
